summary.text: Edgardo Baez is the Republican nominee for Texas's 20th District, challenging Democratic incumbent Joaquin Castro. An Army veteran born in Puerto Rico, he describes himself as a former combat medic, airborne paratrooper and drill sergeant who later became an intensive care nurse and a San Antonio attorney. He lists a Ph.D. from Liberty University and says he has practiced law for about 20 years.

paragraphs.text: Baez was born in Ponce, Puerto Rico, and received a high school diploma from Julio Alvarado High School.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1989 to 2002, and in a San Antonio Report profile he describes himself as a former combat medic, airborne paratrooper and Army drill sergeant.
Baez earned a bachelor's degree from Wayland Baptist University in 2002, a law degree from Texas Southern University in 2004 and a Ph.D. from Liberty University in 2023.

He has worked as an intensive care nurse, EMT, business owner and attorney. His campaign site describes him as a soldier, critical care nurse and attorney for over two decades, and he says he has practiced law in San Antonio for about 20 years.
As of 2025, Baez was affiliated with the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association and the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers.
The San Antonio Report describes him as a published author; at the time of its profile he gave his age as 55 and said he lives in San Antonio.
Baez won the Republican nomination for the 20th District in the March 3, 2026 primary.
